spanish: las estacas del mishkán y las estacas del atrio y sus cuerdas,

findings.issue: הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a definite common noun (H4908), left as the untranslated transliteration mishkán; a common noun must be Spanish.

notes: Estacas, atrio, the repeated construct, and sus cuerdas (3mp suffix) stay within the other tokens.
